name: Delivering Justice
source:
In this game you are a Judge facing a Case of Murder maybe not so easy to be decided.

Is this a crime or things can't be so black and white after all?

[From [url=https://folz.itch.io/delivering-justice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你将扮演一名法官，审理一桩可能并不容易判决的谋杀案。

这究竟是犯罪，还是说，事情本就不能如此非黑即白？

[摘自[url=https://folz.itch.io/delivering-justice]itch.io[/url]]
